prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / framing repair.
Input 1 is the finished Complete King source design. Preserve this EXACT robot, all colors, head, torso, limbs, shield, spiral drill, two main cannon muzzles/pivots, wing tiers, thrusters, thigh and calf launcher pods, pose and drawing style.
Repair ONLY framing: the top-left two red/ivory wing tips are clipped by the image edge, and the boots are too close to the bottom. Zoom the ENTIRE SAME ROBOT OUT uniformly about 12% and add generous transparent margin around ALL extremities. Reconstruct only the few missing millimeters of those two cropped upper-left pointed red wing tips so their complete sharp endpoints match the other wings. Do not alter wing group count, change silhouette, remove equipment, or add a new wing.
Every wing tip, antenna tip, cannon, shield tip, drill point and boot sole must be fully inside the canvas with at least 5% clear margin. Same one full-body three-quarter figure, centered and readable, broad landscape composition. No reframing that enlarges the head separately. No additional robot, inset, title or labels.
Keep current KINETIC_CEL painting and actual transparent background; no checkerboard, floor, glow, hazy backdrop or cast shadow.
